sbh3.0:1.10: Printed *udvejayitavyaḥ*; read *samuttejayitavyaḥ* ‘encouraged’ (Xuanzang 讚勵, T1579 juan 30; cf. sbh1.3:42.40).
sbh3.0:1.13: Printed *durmukha*, *pramādāpagatāyāṁ*; read *bhadramukha*, *pramādopagatāyāṁ* ‘fallen into heedlessness’ (Xuanzang 賢首, 墮放逸, T1579 juan 30; cf. sbh3.2:46.4).
sbh3.0:1.14: Printed *-dhāraka-*, twice; read *-cāraka-* ‘prison’ (Xuanzang 牢獄, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.15: Printed *-vigata-*; read *-nigaḍa-* ‘fetter’ (Xuanzang 杻械枷鎖, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.20: Printed *paramamāno*; read *paramam ārogyaṁ* ‘supreme health’ (Xuanzang 第一無病, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.22: Printed *mahāvidyānukāra-*; read *mahāvidyāndhakāra-* ‘great darkness of ignorance’ (Xuanzang 無明黑闇, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.24: Printed *samohaṁ … paribhokṣyate*; read *amoghaṁ … paribhokṣyase* ‘not in vain’ (Xuanzang 不虛受用, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.27: Printed *svakāya-*; read *svakārya-* ‘his own task’ (Xuanzang 自義, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.37: Printed text omits *pṛcchayā*; supplied from 1.38 (Xuanzang 審問, T1579 juan 30). Printed *-sthānena*; read *-jñānena* (1.101).
sbh3.0:1.52: Printed *tāvad vitarkavicārita vicāracarita*; read *yāvad vitarkacarita* (Xuanzang 廣說乃至尋思行, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.57: Printed *punaryukto*; read *punar ayukto* (Xuanzang 愚鈍, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.63: Printed *dhurair*; read *madhurair* ‘sweet’ (Xuanzang 美妙, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.65: Printed text omits the subject; supplied from Xuanzang 若身中有獨覺種姓、大乘種姓 (T1579 juan 30; cf. 1.69).
sbh3.0:1.71: Printed *prīyate*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 勵力 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.79: Printed *kā yā va ta d dhyānaṁ praviśati*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 悟入其趣，身毛皆竪 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.81: Printed text omits the description of hatred-conduct and the heading of delusion-conduct; the heading supplied from Xuanzang 若有癡行 (T1579 juan 30), who has hatred-conduct as the reverse of lust-conduct (一切與上相違).
sbh3.0:1.84: Printed *dharmānucarito*; read *mānānucarito* ‘of conceit-conduct’ (Xuanzang 慢行, T1579 juan 30; cf. sbh2.0:23.5).
sbh3.0:1.85: Printed *jānātyarthaṁ śuśrūṣate*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 不甚恭敬屬耳樂聞 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.88: Printed *sānukāram*; read *sādhukāram* ‘assent’ (Xuanzang 稱善, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.89: Printed *vicārānucarito*; read *vitarkānucarito* ‘of applied-thought-conduct’ (Xuanzang 尋思行, T1579 juan 30; cf. sbh2.0:23.6).
sbh3.0:1.94: Printed *na puna ḥ*; read *punaḥ punaḥ* ‘again and again’ (Xuanzang 數重, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.105: *Samādhi-saṁbhāra-rakṣopacaya* is parsed as protection-and-accumulation of the requisites for concentration.
sbh3.0:1.107: Printed *apapariṇāya*; read *aparihāṇāya* ‘so as not to decline’ (Xuanzang 為令不退, T1579 juan 30). Printed *pudgalasya*, corrupt; not rendered (Xuanzang 圓滿).
sbh3.0:1.108: Printed *avigatāc*; read *adhigatāc* ‘attained’ (1.109; Xuanzang 己所證得, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.113: Printed *bhūrādhikaka-*, *mu mū kajāta*; read *anūnādhika-* ‘neither less nor more’, *utsukajāta* ‘eager’ (Xuanzang 無增無減, 欣慕, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.114: Printed *śeṣabhāgīyān*; read *viśeṣabhāgīyān* ‘on the side of distinction’ (Xuanzang 順勝分法, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.132: Printed *na divā alpavilokaṁ*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 晝無憒鬧 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.141: Printed *yatrāsamvidhāna*, corrupt; the sense follows 1.138–140 (Xuanzang 飲食支持無所匱乏, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.144: Printed *yesyākṛtāni nottānīkurvanti*; read *ye ’syānuttānīkṛtāny uttānīkurvanti* ‘who make clear what has not been made clear’ (Xuanzang 未開曉處能正開曉, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.165: Printed *kāyasaṁjñatā*, corrupt; the sense follows 1.164, 1.166 and Xuanzang 端身 (T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:1.167: Printed text omits the heading for *praṇidhāya* (1.164); supplied from Xuanzang 云何正願 (T1579 juan 30). Printed *na niḥśocyena*; read *niḥśāṭhyena* ‘free of guile’ (Xuanzang 離諂).
sbh3.0:1.175: Printed *sarvasamāhita-*; read *sarvāsamāhita-* ‘non-concentrated’ (Xuanzang 不定地, T1579 juan 30).
sbh3.0:2.25: Printed *kṣayasya*; read *jñeyasya* ‘to be known’ (Xuanzang 所知事, T1579 juan 30; cf. sbh2.1:14.8).
